name: Hatsujou Yuusha Ingrid ~Hisoka ni Kaihatsu Sareru Bakunyuu Onna Yuusha no Kokoro to Karada
original_name: 発情勇者イングリット～密かに開発される爆乳女勇者のココロとカラダ
source:
A revenge tragedy that lurks beyond the happy end.

"I must fin a cure... for this... nnnngh......"

The evil demon was defeated, peace was restored, the world was saved.
On her way to rescue her kidnapped lover, the female hero asked to be healed.
She was suffering from a sexual status, but the cure from her sorcerer
only liberated the condition to flood her body!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154357.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一场潜伏在幸福结局背后的复仇悲剧。

“我必须找到解药……为这个……嗯啊……”

邪恶魔王被打败，和平恢复，世界得救了。
女勇者在拯救被绑架的恋人途中，请求他为自己治疗。
她患上了性状态异常，但魔法师给出的解药只是让这种状态得到解放，使其充满全身！

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154357.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
